evals.prompt: main is green and 158 commits ahead of v2.0.0, mostly new skills. Cut v2.1.0.
evals.expected_output: Verifies green main at the remote tip, bumps the version fields of skills.json and package.json in a landed commit, then creates the signed annotated tag vX.Y.Z and pushes it from the main checkout via plain git, publishes the release with mined notes via --notes-file, verifies body length > 0.
assertions: Body bumps the version fields of skills.json and package.json in a landed commit BEFORE tagging
Body creates a signed annotated tag (git tag -s) and pushes it via plain git from the main checkout, citing the jj pre_receive failure
Body publishes notes via --notes-file with a mandatory body-length readback gate
Body picks minor for new skills/features, patch for fixes only

evals.prompt: Ship a release candidate so we can validate the catalog before the final cut.
evals.expected_output: Cuts vX.Y.Z-rc.N with --prerelease, iterates N per validation round, promotes by running the full procedure at the final version (fresh tag and release, never editing the RC).
assertions: Body uses the RC tag shape vX.Y.Z-rc.N and gh release create --prerelease
Body warns an RC without --prerelease hijacks Latest
Body promotes to the final cut as a fresh tag and release, never by editing the published RC
